title: derby01: rounds
description: The flow of a match: rounds start with a countdown, last until one team has a car left, then the next one starts on its own. Points add up over the match.

countdown.description: Seconds of countdown before the cars can move.

between.description: Seconds the result shows before the next round.

map.description: town: every round is played in data/town.json (its start slots first, then random spots for any more cars). generated: a town is laid out for the round's cars from the setup's map number with data/generator.json, and the setup screen gets its New map button.
